jobs.description: In the Department of Living Matter Physics (LMP) we seek to fill a number ofPhD positions.- Statistical Physics and Active Matter -The Max Planck Institute for Dynamics and Self-Organization (MPI-DS) at Göttingen, Germany, is an international, interdisciplinary and collaborative environment offering an exceptional research setting. It hosts a range of theoretical and experimental fundamental scientific research and a diverse group of researchers. Altogether, it employs about 300 people. The LMP department engages in a wide range of theoretical research aimed at understanding the dynamics of living systems from a physical perspective. The department is headed by Ramin Golestanian and hosts a number of group leaders, postdoctoral researchers, students, and visitors.The researchThe PhD students will engage in theoretical and/or computational research in Nonequilibrium Statistical Physics and Active Matter, under the supervision of Ramin Golestanian. For more information concerning our current areas of research activity, visit our website (http://www.ds.mpg.de/lmp (http://www.ds.mpg.de/lmp) ).Your profileWe are looking for excellent, enthusiastic and self-motivated early-career researchers with good communication skills to join our research team. The PhD candidate should have:- A Master’s degree (or comparable) in theoretical physics, applied mathematics or related disciplines from a recognized university;- Strong interest in nonequilibrium statistical physics and the physics of living systems across scales;- Ability and desire to work in an international team on inter-disciplinary research topics;- Good command of English, which is the working language of the department. German is an asset but not required.Our offerWe are offering excellent working conditions in a highly interdisciplinary and stimulating research environment. Salary and working hours are in accordance with the funding guidelines of the Max Planck Society for junior scientists. Working hours are fulltime; salary is 2/3 of E13 TVöD-Bund. Furthermore, we offer opportunities regarding work life balance as well as health promotion services. The PhD position is limited to three years. The starting date is flexible.The Max-Planck Society is committed to achieving the highest level of excellence and diversity. We encourage applications from women, especially in areas where they are underrepresented, which includes theoretical physics. Moreover, we are committed to providing suitable working environment for everyone including individuals with disabilities.Your applicationTo apply, please follow this link (https://jobs.b-ite.com/en/jobposting/64bbb9935c7fc269f86d9f96bf4a8e06636784110/apply)  and submit your CV, your academic records, a statement of your research interests, and contacts of two referees. Processing of applications will start after the deadline of 1st December 2026. While we may continue to receive applications until 1st April 2027, the positions will be filled as soon as suitable candidates are identified. Therefore, you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.For questions, please contact:Prof. Dr. Ramin Golestanian Tel. +49 551 5176-100Email: golestanian-office@ds.mpg.de (https://mailto:golestanian-office@ds.mpg.de)  Max Planck Institute forDynamics and Self-OrganizationProf. Dr. Ramin GolestanianAm Faßberg 1737077 GöttingenGermanyErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Physik, Theoretische Physik

effectively to an interdisciplinary research team- Excellent written and spoken EnglishWe offer- The position provides the opportunity to work on clearly defined projects using existing, jobs.occupation: Global Head of Data Privacy (f/m/d) (Fachanwalt/-anwältin)
jobs.description: Job RequirementsDo you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?Then come and join our global team as Global Head of Data Privacy (f/m/d) for the Business Area Diagnostics (DX) of Siemens Healthineers. You will shape and lead a globally connected data privacy function, driving meaningful impact across an international healthcare business while building and developing a small team of experts.Choose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.Location: Frankfurter Str. 110, Eschborn, Germany.Your tasks and responsibilities:* You define and drive the global Data Privacy strategy for Diagnostics, enabling business growth, digital transformation, AI innovation, and responsible data use worldwide.* You build and continuously evolve a scalable, risk-based privacy organization and governance framework across regions, functions, and business lines.* You lead, coach, and develop a small globally distributed team, fostering collaboration, inclusion, and continuous growth.* You serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating complex privacy requirements into pragmatic, business-enabling solutions.* You drive privacy-by-design principles across AI, advanced analytics, cloud technologies, and product development, ensuring the ethical and responsible use of data.* You oversee the global privacy management system, including policies, tools, controls, risk management, audits, incident response, performance metrics, and executive reporting.* You partner closely with business, R&D, Legal, Compliance, Security, and Commercial teams to enable innovative business models and global data collaborations.* You represent Siemens Healthineers DX in interactions with regulatory authorities, customers, and industry forums, shaping the dialogue on data privacy and emerging technologies.To find out more about the specific business, have a look at Laboratory Diagnostics - Siemens HealthineersYour qualifications and experience:* You hold a university degree in Law, Privacy, Information Technology Law, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, or a related field; additional privacy certifications such as IAPP CIPP/E or CIPM are highly desirable.* You have several years of substantial hands-on experience in data privacy, data protection, compliance, legal or related regulatory leadership functions within healthcare, medical technology, life sciences, pharma or other highly regulated industries.* You have successfully led global privacy programs, governance frameworks, and distributed expert organizations across multiple jurisdictions, preferably in a senior leadership role such as Global Head of Privacy, Group DPO, or equivalent.* You possess deep expertise in GDPR, UK GDPR, HIPAA, healthcare-related data privacy requirements, international data protection regulations, and emerging AI governance frameworks.* You bring extensive experience in privacy risk management, incident response, audits, DPIAs, and regulatory interactions with supervisory authorities worldwide.* You have strong knowledge of Privacy by Design principles and experience supporting data-driven products, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.Your attributes and skills:* You thrive in environments where not everything is predefined and enjoy building structures, organizations, and sustainable solutions from the ground up. You combine strategic vision with a hands-on mindset and enjoy translating complex regulatory requirements into practical, business-oriented solutions.* You are an inspiring leader with a proven track record of building and developing teams, navigating change, and bringing people together across functions, regions, and cultures.* You act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders and demonstrate outstanding communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills in an international environment.* You demonstrate high integrity, sound judgment, and independence when addressing sensitive regulatory, ethical, and compliance-related matters.* You are fluent in English and excel in navigating complex global stakeholder landscapes with confidence, credibility, and diplomacy.Our global team:Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.Our culture:Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success.Check our Careers Site at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careersAs an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.Wish to find out more before applying? Contact us: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com, if you wish to discuss any initial questions with our recruitment team. The contact person handling this job ad is Petra Hübener.We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open.

The position is suitable for part-time work and initially limited till 31rd December 2029. The GWDG strives for long-term cooperation. If interested, there is the possibility of a doctorate.The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing center for the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society. The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the University of Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG operates the HLRN-IV system “Emmy”, one of the most powerful computers in the world.As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG offers technical support to researchers and students from various science domains using sophisticated computer codes, including earth system science, life science, and engineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. At the same time, we aim to improve our close collaboration with the German Aerospace Center (DLR), and specialized computing centers including the German Climate Computing Center (DKRZ) and the Institute for Advanced Simulation Jülich (IAS-JSC).As part of our AI Service Center for Sensitive and Critical Infrastructure (KISSKI) we have created a number of AI-based services that offer high levels of security and privacy due to being processed on our own hardware. The position will be located within the subproject “KISSKI-EvoKS” and closely collaborate with customers from SMEs and Startups to develop prototypes and workflows that lead to PoCs and Blueprints. Those customers will come predominantly from sectors with high data protection requirements.The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science (CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with an opportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing, AI, and Machine Learning.ResponsibilitiesWe have a wide range of potential responsibilities that we would like to discuss with you. Your responsibilities in our team could include, for example:- Design, implement, and optimize high-performance storage solutions tailored for AI and HPC workloads- Conduct research on scalable, cost-effective storage architectures suitable for AI training and HPC simulations in resource-constrained environments- Develop and deploy data management strategies for large-scale AI datasets, including data lifecycle management, versioning, backup, and security (e.g., GDPR-compliant data handling)- Investigate and prototype AI-optimized storage systems leveraging technologies such as NVMe, SSD caching, and distributed storage (e.g., Ceph, MinIO, Lustre)- Support SMEs in evaluating and selecting appropriate HPC and AI storage solutions- Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to ensure storage systems meet the demands of AI model training, inference, and real-time processing- Develop best practice guidelines and toolkits for SMEs to manage AI/HPC data efficiently and security- Provide technical advisory and training to SME teams on data storage, performance monitoring, and data governance- Monitor and benchmark storage performance, ensuring low latency, high throughput, and cost-efficiency for AI/HPC applicationsRequirements- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related field- Experience in HPC systems, storage infrastructure, and AI data engineering- Proven experience with high-performance storage technologies (e.g., Lustre, GPFS, Ceph, NFS, S3-compatible storage)- Strong knowledge of AI/ML data pipelines, including data ingestion, preprocessing, and model training workflows- Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration tools in HPC/AI environments- Familiarity with cloud storage platforms- Experience in data lifecycle management, data versioning, and metadata management- Solid understanding of data security, privacy (GDPR), and compliance in AI applications- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills- Excellent communication skills and ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders- Very good German skills (C1)- Very good English skills (C1)- Willingness to travel on businessDesirable- Experience in research or innovation projects related to HPC, AI, or data infrastructure- Knowledge of AI-driven storage optimization (e.g., predictive data placement, auto-tiering)- Familiarity with open-source HPC/AI frameworks (e.g., Slurm, Singularity, MLflow, Kubeflow)- Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash) and system administration (Linux/UNIX)Our offer- Flexible working hours and opportunity for mobile working- A modern, diverse, and exceptional work environment with close proximity to academia and research at the intersection of several innovative technology sectors- An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center- Collaboration in a competent and committed team- Qualification and further development of your skills- Social benefits of the public sectorYour applicationHave we sparked your interest? Then please send us your application by 08.11.2026 via our online form:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
